name: gta-authored-synthetic-v1
provenance: Original fictional dialogue, one-second loudness numbers, scene-change timestamps, and temporal annotations authored for this repository. No real GTA media, streamer speech, or Twitch metadata was copied. Model responses are absent from every case.
split_note: The holdout partition is a public secondary regression set. It has been inspected by the authors and is not a blind test or evidence of generalization.

cases.description: A fictional police chase ends in a barrier collision and a spoken reaction.

transcript.text: The cops are chasing me down this street.
We crashed into a barrier!
I cannot stop laughing.

cases.description: An attempted ramp jump misses its landing; the fictional speaker explains the failure.

transcript.text: I am lining up the ramp.
I tried the jump but missed the landing.
That was hilarious.

cases.description: Unexpected NPC theft described in invented dialogue, with no loudness peak.

transcript.text: I left the door open for one second.
An NPC just stole my car!
That was hilarious.

cases.description: Invented dialogue followed by an explicit funny-dialogue cue; no claim the text is objectively funny.

transcript.text: The mechanic asked whether my car had insurance.
I said the doors are the only parts still insured. That was hilarious.
I cannot stop laughing.
